items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: as long as I have known him he never threw nothin' my way

ctx.x: When was the first time they used the term "Bebop"

... I think Diz named it himself ... I helped start him off ... as long as I have known him he never threw nothin' my way ... not once ... [shows picture] ... the thing of it is when he was making his debut, as you might say at the Apollo theater with his new modern music group, a few of us showed up to try to give him a send-off and there's a picture of myself, were on the Apollo theater stage ... bringing him on to introduce modern jazz -- Bebop -- to the public. That's me helpin' him out. But he's never thrown…

Bebop.
... People didn't accept it. It was hard for it to be accepted, until the musicians themselves, just like the rock and rollers - they make their parents like it if you like it or not, you're gonna have to like it sooner or later. But they made one mistake, they didn't learn the basics first...
